topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I say, this be a queer business, like the time ol' Maester Barton’s cattle wandered off in a fog, and we found 'em miles away, looking right bewildered. This here car, dragged off from its own rightful place, seems a mite unnatural. The good lord knows what course this takes, but a man should feel secure on his own land, shouldn’t he? I’ve heard of folk causing trouble, of thieves and such, but to have such a thing happen where you think you’re safe... It makes one wonder what else might come to pass. Best to keep a watchful eye on what we hold dear, and pray to the saints for a swift and fair resolution. Mayhaps there’s a misunderstanding, and all will be set right soon enough.
